ios.desc:
CountdownDuck: The Ultimate Countdown & Event Tracker!
Perfect for vacations, birthdays, deadlines, and more.

Why Choose Countdown Duck?

• Count Up or Down: Track events coming up or measure time since unforgettable moments.
• Customizable Widgets: Create widgets with fonts, colors, and emojis to showcase your countdowns on your home or lock screen.
• Calendar Sync: Import events from your calendar or create new ones to sync seamlessly.
• Fun Personalization: Assign emojis to your timers and choose vibrant colors to match your vibe.
• Grid & List Views: Organize your events in a grid or list for easy tracking.
• Repeat Options: Set timers to repeat daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly—ideal for birthdays and anniversaries.
• Designed for Apple Devices: Enjoy a smooth experience on iPhone, iPad, and even your lock screen widgets.

Perfect For:
• Birthdays and anniversaries
• Holidays and vacations
• Recurring reminders
• Milestones and deadlines
• Counting time since your last coffee break!
• Download CountdownDuck Today!

Stay organised, celebrate every moment, and create beautifully designed widgets—all in one fun, intuitive app.

Never Miss a Special Moment with CountdownDuck!
CountdownDuck is the ultimate app for tracking your most important events, milestones, and celebrations. Whether it’s a birthday, anniversary, wedding, vacation, or any other special day, CountdownDuck makes it effortless to stay organized and prepared.

Why You’ll Love CountdownDuck:
• Customisable Countdown Timers: Create personalised countdowns for any event with custom titles, themes, and colours.
• Widget Support: Add stunning widgets to your Home Screen or Lock Screen for instant event tracking.
• Sync with Your Calendar: Seamlessly sync events and reminders from your calendar to never miss an important date.
• Daily Event Notifications: Get timely reminders and notifications as your special days approach.
• Milestone Tracking: Celebrate the days, months, or years since important events. Perfect for anniversaries, work achievements, or personal goals.
• Multiple Event Categories: Track birthdays, holidays, appointments, deadlines, and more.
• Designed for Your Busy Life
• CountdownDuck works seamlessly on both iPhone and iPad. With intuitive features and beautifully designed widgets, it’s your perfect companion to make every moment count.
• Set your countdowns to repeat yearly, monthly, weekly or daily
• Sort your events from the closest to the most distant
• Dark Mode
• Pick
